I bought this water storage bladder over a month ago. It is replacing five 7 gallon water containers I've been using. I own a large tree farm over an hour away from my home. I have a travel trailer on my property I stay in while I am up there. I use to have to fill five 7 gallon containers to bring them with me to my property over an hour away. And that didn't even fill the water holding tank. This new 63 gallon water storage bladder is a life saver. I put it in the back of my truck and fill it with the water hose. When I get to my property, I just attach a water hose to the bladder and stick the other end into my water storage tank and let gravity transfer the water. I should have had this years ago. It is easy, efficient, and very durable. Thank you!

I had this on a platform three feet of the ground. It was full of water. I had to get it off, so I bit the bullet and rolled it off. It survived the fall with no problems. I used it at rocklahoma with 102 -104 degree temperatures. Water in full sum will get extremely hot.
